title: Beyond Thresholds: A Quality-Aware Decision Intelligence Framework for Cold Chain IoT Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.15082v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cold chain logistics has advanced technologically, yet most deployed systems remain reactive monitors, not decision-making agents: thresholds trigger alerts, but nothing relates violations to cumulative product degradation or converts degradation signals into logistics decisions. We address this gap with a Quality-Aware Decision Intelligence (QADI) framework combining three capabilities: a structured quality state representation, $S_q = [L, Q, U, R]$ -- remaining shelf life, degradation rate, estimation uncertainty, and operational risk, all derived and computable from the framework equations; a hybrid quality modeling layer combining physics-based microbial kinetics with a data-driven correction term; and a reasoning layer built on Microsoft Phi-4~\cite{Phi4} with retrieval-augmented generation over a structured domain knowledge base. translated_title: 超越阈值：冷链物联网系统的质量感知决策智能框架
translated_abstract: 冷链物流在技术上已取得进步，但大多数部署的系统仍是被动监控器，而非决策代理：阈值触发警报，但没有任何机制将违规与累积产品退化联系起来，或将退化信号转化为物流决策。我们通过一个质量感知决策智能（QADI）框架来解决这一差距，该框架结合了三种能力：结构化质量状态表示，$S_q = [L, Q, U, R]$——剩余保质期、退化速率、估计不确定性和操作风险，所有这些均可从框架方程中推导和计算；一个混合质量建模层，将基于物理的微生物动力学与数据驱动的修正项相结合；以及一个基于Microsoft Phi-4构建的推理层，通过检索增强生成在结构化领域知识库上进行操作。我们针对五个基线进行了基准测试——阈值监控、纯物理模型、物理加噪声模型、优化模型……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种质量感知决策智能（QADI）框架，通过结合结构化状态表示、混合质量建模和基于大模型的推理，将冷链系统从被动监控转变为主动决策代理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Quality-Aware Decision Intelligence (QADI) framework that transforms cold chain systems from passive monitoring to proactive decision-making by integrating structured state representation, hybrid quality modeling, and LLM-based reasoning.
